records.description: A step we often overlook as we developer our next big idea is market research. Supascout is here to help you understand users' feedback on existing products, and giving you insights on how you could do better by addressing those satisfactions and frustrations.

records.name: Medicine Tracker
records.tagline: Never miss a dose, stay on track
records.description: Managing medications shouldn’t be a hassle. Our Medicine Reminder app is your personal health assistant, ensuring you never miss a dose. With user-friendly reminders, smart scheduling, and an intuitive design. Stay on top of your health simple and stress-free.

records.name: Teezy
records.tagline: Dental Health for whole family
records.description: Teezy is your solution for managing dental care, whether for yourself or your family. Track individual teeth, schedule appointments, visualize your dental health, and manage multiple profiles—all in one app. Teezy makes it easy to stay on top of everything.

records.name: Localeasy.io
records.tagline: Free easy localization management
records.description: Localeasy.io is a free and user-friendly localization management platform that simplifies multi-language project workflows with GitHub/GitLab integrations, AI translations, and JSON file handling.
